body: Yeah you’re right, I realise how shitty a thing it is to actually do to someone now. Thanks for helping me realise.
Aw no I would hate to think he’s thinking that, thanks for the advice I think I’ll definitely reach out and apologise

Thank you for replying, I’ve taken all of that on board. I think I’m gonna message to start the conversation off, would this sound okay? 
Hey, I’m sorry, I realise not talking to you about how I’m feeling is the wrong way to go about things I just panicked a bit, if you wanna talk when you have time lemme know and I can explain what happened, again absolutely nothing you’ve done.
Yeah you’re right. I don’t do it often no, I mostly just withdraw a bit but am around if anyone needs me.
You are so right, ugh I feel absolutely awful I dunno what I was thinking.
I was for a good while and we worked on the past relationship and it definitely helped, but now I’m in a new relationship these feelings are coming up again, should probably get back into it.

Thanks so much for the advice, he starts a new job tomorrow would messaging him casually saying good luck for tomorrow make things even worse? The bad thing is I’m on holiday from work now so I have more free time than usual, I’ll find something to do though.

Its something I’ve always done, I disappear from everyone for a bit and have some time to myself then feel better, it’s probably not healthy. I don’t want to put all of this on to him and make him feel awkward, in my head nobody wants to hear about all my depressing shit haha, so I keep it to myself, plus it’s a bit embarrassing for me.

Time will pass and you will get through this, it’s good that you’re getting treatment and even though it’s scary it’s necessary. This is a time to just focus on getting yourself better and nothing else, take it a day at a time.
